mapper.select: SELECT do_id AS diseaseId, disease_name_chinese AS diseaseName FROM nkb.disease WHERE disease_name_chinese = #{diseaseName} LIMIT 1
SELECT disease_name_chinese FROM nkb.disease WHERE do_id IN #{id}
SELECT DISTINCT is_a FROM nkb.disease_hierarchy WHERE do_id IN #{id}
SELECT gene_id AS geneId, gene_symbol AS geneSymbol FROM nkb.ncbi_gene WHERE gene_symbol = #{geneSymbol} LIMIT 1

SELECT gene_variant_id FROM nkb.gene_variant WHERE gene_id = #{geneId} AND (gene_variant = #{variant} OR (#{oriVariant} IS NOT NULL AND ori_variant = #{oriVariant}) OR (#{variant} IS NOT NULL AND ori_variant LIKE CONCAT('%(', #{variant}, ')')) OR gene_variant LIKE CONCAT('%(', #{variant}, ')')) ORDER BY gene_variant_id LIMIT 5
SELECT gene_variant_id FROM nkb.gene_variant WHERE gene_id = #{geneId} AND gene_variant LIKE CONCAT(#{classPrefix}, '%') ORDER BY gene_variant_id LIMIT 5
mapper.sql: SELECT a.annotation_id AS annotationId, a.gene_variant_id AS mutationId, gv.gene_variant AS nodeName, a.drug_id AS drugId, d.drug_name_chinese AS drugName, d.drug_name AS drugNameEn, a.disease_id AS diseaseId, dis.disease_name_chinese AS disease, r.relationship_chinese AS relationship, a.relationship_id AS relationshipId, a.direct_target_or_not AS directTarget, et.evidence_type_chinese AS evidenceType, ep.evidence_phase_chinese AS evidencePhase, a.evidence_phase_id AS evidencePhaseId, er.evidence_ranking_chinese AS evidenceRanking, a.other_test_required AS otherTestRequired, a.has_previous_clinical_result AS hasPreviousClinicalResult, a.annotation_chinese AS annotation, (SELECT ad.approving_agency FROM nkb.approved_drug ad WHERE ad.drug_id = a.drug_id AND ad.disease_id = a.disease_id LIMIT 1) AS approvingAgency FROM nkb.variant_drug_annotation a JOIN nkb.gene_variant gv ON gv.gene_variant_id = a.gene_variant_id LEFT JOIN nkb.drug d ON d.drug_id = a.drug_id LEFT JOIN nkb.disease dis ON dis.do_id = a.disease_id LEFT JOIN nkb.evidence_type et ON et.evidence_type_id = a.evidence_type_id LEFT JOIN nkb.evidence_ranking er ON er.evidence_ranking_id = a.evidence_ranking_id LEFT JOIN nkb.evidence_phase ep ON ep.evidence_phase_id = a.evidence_phase_id LEFT JOIN nkb.relationship r ON r.relationship_id = a.relationship_id

a.checking_status_id = 2 AND a.relationship_id IN (1, 4, 6) AND a.evidence_phase_id > 11 AND a.evidence_type_id = 2 AND IFNULL(d.checking_status_id, 0) != 3 AND dis.checking_status_id = 2 AND a.mutation_type IN (#{mutationType}, 'S/G')
mapper.select: SELECT gv.gene_variant_id AS mutationId, gv.gene_variant AS variantName, gv.ori_variant AS oriVariant, e.effect_chinese AS effectText, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(pv.gene_variant ORDER BY pv.gene_variant_id SEPARATOR ',') FROM nkb.gene_variant_parent p JOIN nkb.gene_variant pv ON pv.gene_variant_id = p.parent_variant_id WHERE p.gene_variant_id = gv.gene_variant_id) AS parentVariants FROM nkb.gene_variant gv JOIN nkb.ncbi_gene g ON g.gene_id = gv.gene_id JOIN nkb.checking_status cs ON cs.status_id = gv.checking_status_id LEFT JOIN nkb.effect e ON e.effect_id = gv.effect_id WHERE g.gene_symbol = #{geneSymbol} AND gv.gene_variant = #{geneVariant} AND cs.checking_status = 'Approved' LIMIT 1
SELECT p.parent_variant_id FROM nkb.gene_variant_parent p WHERE p.gene_variant_id = #{mutationId} ORDER BY p.parent_variant_id

SELECT gv.gene_variant_id AS mutationId, g.gene_symbol AS gene, gv.gene_variant AS variantName, e.effect_chinese AS effectText FROM nkb.gene_variant gv JOIN nkb.ncbi_gene g ON g.gene_id = gv.gene_id JOIN nkb.checking_status cs ON cs.status_id = gv.checking_status_id LEFT JOIN nkb.effect e ON e.effect_id = gv.effect_id WHERE cs.checking_status = 'Approved' AND (g.gene_symbol LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') OR gv.gene_variant LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY (g.gene_symbol = #{keyword}) DESC, (gv.gene_variant = #{keyword}) DESC, g.gene_symbol, gv.gene_variant LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT ade.drug_id AS drugId, ade.disease_id AS diseaseId, ade.approving_agency AS approvingAgency, ade.approval_description_chinese AS approvalDescription FROM nkb.approved_drug_evw ade WHERE ade.checking_status = 'Approved' AND ade.drug_id IN #{dId} AND ade.disease_id IN #{dzId}

SELECT g.drug_id AS drugId, g.disease_id AS diseaseId, g.guideline_type AS guidelineType, g.guideline_title AS guidelineTitle, g.guideline_description_chinese AS guidelineDescription FROM nkb.guideline_drug_evw g WHERE g.checking_status = 'Approved' AND g.drug_id IN #{dId} AND g.disease_id IN #{dzId} ORDER BY g.guideline_type, g.record_id

SELECT t.annotation_id AS annotationId, vda.drug_id AS drugId, d.drug_name_chinese AS drugName, ct.clinical_trial_id AS trialId, ct.official_title_chinese AS title, ct.condition_chinese AS trialCondition, ct.phase AS phase, ct.location_chinese AS location, CASE ct.phase WHEN 'Phase IV' THEN 6 WHEN 'Phase III' THEN 5 WHEN 'Phase II/III' THEN 4 WHEN 'Phase II' THEN 3 WHEN 'Phase I/II' THEN 2 WHEN 'Phase I' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS phaseOrder FROM nkb.variant_drug_anno_trial t JOIN nkb.clinical_trial ct ON ct.clinical_trial_id = t.clinical_trial_id JOIN nkb.variant_drug_annotation vda ON vda.annotation_id = t.annotation_id LEFT JOIN nkb.drug d ON d.drug_id = vda.drug_id WHERE t.annotation_id IN #{aId} AND ct.recruiting_status IN ('Recruiting', 'Enrolling by invitation') AND ct.checking_status_id = 2
AND ct.clinical_trial_id NOT IN (SELECT e.clinical_trial_id FROM nkb.clinical_trial_exclude_disease e WHERE e.disease_id IN #{eId})
ORDER BY phaseOrder DESC, ct.clinical_trial_id
SELECT gv.gene_variant_id AS mutationId, gv.gene_variant AS variantName FROM nkb.gene_variant gv WHERE gv.gene_variant_id IN #{mId}

SELECT gv.gene_variant FROM nkb.gene_variant gv JOIN nkb.checking_status cs ON cs.status_id = gv.checking_status_id WHERE cs.checking_status = 'Approved' AND gv.gene_variant_id IN #{mId} ORDER BY FIELD(gv.gene_variant_id, #{mId})
SELECT DISTINCT h.do_id FROM nkb.disease_hierarchy h WHERE h.is_a IN #{dId}

SELECT gd.gene_description_chinese AS geneDescription, gd.related_pathway AS relatedPathway, gd.pathway_description_chinese AS pathwayDescription FROM nkb.gene_description gd JOIN nkb.ncbi_gene g ON g.gene_id = gd.gene_id WHERE g.gene_symbol = #{geneSymbol} AND gd.checking_status_id = 2 AND gd.gene_description_chinese IS NOT NULL AND gd.gene_description_chinese != '' ORDER BY gd.annotation_id LIMIT 1

SELECT d.description_chinese AS variantDescription, d.smple_desc_chinese AS simpleDescription, d.annotation_type AS annotationType FROM nkb.gene_variant_description d WHERE d.gene_variant_id = #{mutationId} AND d.checking_status_id = 2 AND d.description_chinese IS NOT NULL AND d.description_chinese != '' ORDER BY d.annotation_id LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ct.clinical_trial_id) FROM nkb.clinical_trial ct WHERE (ct.recruiting_status = 'Recruiting' OR ct.recruiting_status = 'Enrolling by invitation') AND ct.checking_status_id = 2 AND ct.clinical_trial_id IN (SELECT t.clinical_trial_id FROM nkb.variant_drug_anno_trial t WHERE t.annotation_id = #{annotationId}) AND ct.clinical_trial_id NOT IN (SELECT e.clinical_trial_id FROM nkb.clinical_trial_exclude_disease e WHERE e.disease_id IN #{dId})
